cli.usage:
brain-kit {version}

Usage: brain-kit <command> [options]

Commands available in this version:
  hook <stop|session-start>                   entry point for the Claude Code plugin hooks (reads the event JSON from stdin)
  validate [dir] [--only-problems] [--json]   check a vault against the Open Knowledge Format and this vault's own house rules
  --version                                   print the version
  --help                                      print this help

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failure, 2 usage or not inside a vault, 3 degraded, 4 required source not read, 69 network or connector unavailable, 75 postponed (retry later).
validate.path_not_a_directory: brain-kit validate: "{dir}" is not a directory.
validate.no_vault: brain-kit validate: no brain-kit vault found from "{dir}" or any directory above it (looking for {config} and {index}).
validate.explain_must: These findings mean the bundle is not conformant to the Open Knowledge Format.
validate.explain_should: These findings mean the vault departs from the format's own guidance, without breaking conformance.
validate.explain_house: These findings mean the vault departs from its own house rules: what its configuration declares, plus the defaults it left in place. The format defines no conformance tier for them.
validate.explain_defect: These findings carry a ruler and level this command does not recognize. This is a defect in brain-kit itself, not in your vault; please report it.
validate.explain_stale: This is informational only and never affects the exit code.
validate.stale_none: No note has passed its stale_after date.
validate.verdict_clean: Result: no findings. The vault is conformant and has no departures.
validate.verdict_clean_with_stale: Result: no conformance or house findings. The vault is conformant; the stale notes listed above are informational only and do not change this.
validate.verdict_warnings_only: Result: the vault is conformant. Every finding above was downgraded to a warning; nothing blocks this run.
validate.verdict_not_blocking: Result: the findings above do not fail this run, because this vault sets validate.fail_on to "{failOn}". Set it to "any" to fail on all of them.
validate.verdict_blocking: Result: the vault is conformant to the format, but findings above (guidance or house rules) block this run.
validate.verdict_broken: Result: the vault is not conformant to the format.
validate.verdict_unexpected: Result: at least one finding could not be classified; this run cannot say whether the vault is conformant. See the tool defect section above.
common.shape_unreadable: {field} is present but its shape could not be read (see PARSER_LIMITS in src/frontmatter.mjs)
common.timestamp_form: {field} "{value}" is not an ISO 8601 datetime with an explicit UTC offset, which section 5 requires for every timestamp-valued key
spec.type_required.unterminated: frontmatter opens with "---" but is never closed with a second one, so type cannot be confirmed; close the block
spec.type_required.no_frontmatter: type is required but missing (the file has no frontmatter at all)
spec.type_required.no_type_key: type is required but missing (this file has frontmatter, but no type key in it)
spec.type_required.empty: type is present but empty; it must be a non-empty string
spec.index_no_frontmatter.outside_root: index.md is reserved and must carry no frontmatter (only the root index may declare okf_version)
spec.index_no_frontmatter.extra_key: the root index may declare only okf_version and nothing else; found "{found}"
spec.log_format.has_frontmatter: log.md is reserved and should carry no frontmatter
spec.log_format.heading_calendar: log heading "## {heading}" is in YYYY-MM-DD form but names a day that does not exist; section 9 requires a real ISO 8601 date
spec.log_format.heading_form: log heading "## {heading}" is a date written in another form; section 9 requires date headings in ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD form
spec.log_format.heading_not_a_date: log heading "## {heading}" is not a date heading; a log groups its entries under dates
spec.log_format.ordering: log dates must run from most recent to oldest; "{date}" comes after "{previous}"
spec.generated_actor.missing_actor: generated.by is required but missing or empty
spec.verified_events.empty: verified is present but carries no events; remove the key or add at least one with by and at
spec.verified_events.missing_actor: verified[{index}].by is required but missing or empty
spec.verified_events.missing_timestamp: verified[{index}].at is required but missing or empty
spec.status_enum.invalid: status "{value}" is not one of draft, stable, deprecated
spec.stale_after_format.invalid: stale_after "{value}" must be an ISO 8601 datetime with an explicit UTC offset; section 5 requires this for every timestamp-valued key, so a plain date is no longer accepted here
spec.sources_resource.missing_resource: sources[{index}] is missing a non-empty resource
house.required_fields.missing: {key} is required by this vault's own configuration but is missing
house.required_fields.empty: {key} is required by this vault's own configuration but is empty
house.forbidden_fields.present: {key} is forbidden by this vault's own configuration but is present
house.type_enum.invalid: type "{value}" is not one of this vault's allowed types: {allowed}
house.extension_fields.boolean: {field} "{value}" must be a boolean (true or false)
house.extension_fields.date: {field} "{value}" must be an ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD)
house.extension_fields.enum: {field} "{value}" is not one of this vault's allowed values: {allowed}
house.link_style.file_relative: link {seen} starts with a slash, which resolves against the host, not the repository, and breaks where a human reviews the change; this vault requires file-relative links
house.link_style.bundle_absolute: link {seen} does not start with a slash; this vault requires bundle-absolute links
house.link_target_exists.broken: link target "{target}" does not resolve to anything in this vault (resolved to "{resolved}")
house.link_target_exists.unwalked: link target "{target}" exists on disk but is not part of what this command walked (resolved to "{resolved}"); it sits under validate.ignore_paths, a dot-entry or node_modules, so this run cannot vouch for it
house.no_wikilinks.forbidden: [[{target}]] is a wikilink, which this vault forbids; use a standard markdown link instead
house.root_okf_version.missing: the root index does not declare okf_version, which this vault requires
house.root_okf_version.mismatch: the root index declares okf_version "{value}" but this vault is configured for "{expected}"
lint.index_completeness.missing_index: the directory "{dir}" holds a markdown file but has no index.md
lint.index_completeness.dir_not_linked: the root index does not link the first-level directory "{dir}"
lint.orphans.unreachable: this note is not reachable by following links from the root index
lint.columns.missing_table: this file has no table to check against its configured column headings
lint.tables.missing_blank_line: this table has no blank line before its header row; this change touched the table, so the whole table was checked, not just the lines it added
lint.tables.duplicate_row: this data row duplicates the row at line {line}; this change touched the table, so the whole table was checked, not just the lines it added
lint.tables.cell_too_long: cell {index} has {length} characters, over the configured maximum of {max}; this change touched the table, so the whole table was checked, not just the lines it added
lint.style.forbidden_char: this line was added by this change and uses the forbidden character "{char}"; style only judges lines a change added, not prose that was already in the vault
lint.secrets.pattern_matched: an added line matches a secret-shaped pattern ({pattern}); never paste, print or share the matched text, rotate the credential now and follow the incident response steps in SECURITY.md
lint.privacy.linked_into_confidential: this file sits outside every confidential directory but links into one ("{target}"), exposing a confidential note from a place meant to be shared more broadly
lint.privacy.confidential_outside: this note carries confidential: true but sits outside every directory the configuration marks confidential
lint.attribution.missing_source_id: sources[{index}] has no id, so no footnote can ever anchor a claim to it
lint.attribution.unknown_footnote: this footnote key ("{key}") matches no id in sources; per section 5.1, a footnote anchors a claim to a real source
lint.attribution.source_not_anchored: sources declares the id "{id}" but no footnote in the body ever anchors a claim to it; per section 5.1, a note crossing more than one source anchors each claim
